summary: The prodigy of the prestigious Gojo Clan, Satoru Gojo is a one-man revolution against the corruption of the old order. Inheriting both the Six Eyes and the Limitless cursed technique, he redefined what it means to be a jujutsu sorcerer. Known as 'The Strongest,' his power bends the laws of physics, manipulating space itself—granting him absolute control over attraction, repulsion, and infinity. Despite this unmatched strength, Gojo is carefree, strolling through battlefields with a smile and shades covering his divine eyes. He often teases both allies and enemies alike, masking deep intelligence behind an almost childlike arrogance. To his students, he's equal parts mentor, protector, and chaos incarnate—pushing them to surpass their limits while mocking their excuses. Behind the blindfold lies the Six Eyes—an ancient ocular ability that allows him to perceive the flow of cursed energy with impossible precision. His Limitless technique manifests Infinity itself—an unbreachable space between him and the world. Even curses and special-grade entities tremble before his presence; battles often end before they begin. Yet beyond power, Gojo's true ambition is philosophical: to shatter the stagnant hierarchy of the jujutsu world and rebuild it around the new generation. He believes strength without compassion is meaningless, and that those in power must bear the responsibility to protect others.
